IS 810 : 1991 Internal Combustion Engines - Engine Valves - SpecificationUDC 621.646.2 : 621.43 : 629.7TED 2Reaffirmed 20201 Scope1.1 This standard specifies the general requirements for inletand exhaust valves for all internal combustion engines other than for aircraft use.1.2 Sodium filled valves, phosphate valves, shrouded valves andvalves with more than 100 mm head diameter are not covered by thisstandard.1.3 The methods of test for quality characteristics of enginevalves are covered in IS 12969 : 1990.2 ReferencesIS 1586 : 1968Methods for Rockwell hardness test (B and C scales) forsteelIS 1608 : 1972Method for tensile testing of steel productsIS 3073 : 1967Assessment of surface roughnessIS 3658 : 1981Code of practice for liquid penetrant flaw detectionIS 3703 : 1981Code of practice for magnetic particle flaw detectionIS 7494 : 1981Steel for valves for internal combustion enginesIS 12969 : 1990Method of test for quality characteristics of valves
